svg.text: Starling 2 Max — board-level wiring, every board seen from above, front → right
Outlines and connector positions traced from ModalAI's VOXL 2 connector drawing and M0129 photo (5 px = 1 mm, ±1 mm). Downward faces are drawn seen through the board.
Connections per ModalAI's REV4 compute diagram, the 2026-10-14 bench session and the owner's hardware check (2026-10-20). ▶ = side a cable leaves from.
J2 · J3 · J5 · J10 · J19 · the add-on board stacks on this face
VOXL 2 — bottom face, facing down (seen through)
QRB5165 SIP · J4 · J6–J9 · J18 · the M0173 camera board sits under this face
J1, VREG and LED pads face the rear
ESC VREG 5 V → J4-1 · GND → J4-2 · J4-3/4 not wired
UART 3.3 V · J18-2 TX → J1-2 RX · J18-3 RX ← J1-3 TX · pin 4 GND
own USB hub · J11 USB 3 free
No room left for an M0062
under the VOXL 2, on J6 + J7
plugs: PH-4 in · SM-3 out · PH-2 fan
LED chain · 16 px, 4 per arm, 60 LED/m
ring from the arm nearest the pads
ESC, power face up — LED pads

Motors: PX4 Quad X (M1 front-right, M2 rear-left, M3 front-left, M4 rear-right). ESC ID → motor from VOXL_ESC_FUNC1–4 = 102,103,101,104 on both aircraft; with the power face up, each ESC corner sits next to its own motor. ESC ID0 also drives the NeoPixel pad.
⚪ = drawn by ModalAI, not inspected on our aircraft.
